missing_hardware_facts: Replacement or cross-swapped FTS02 board identity and wiring check.
Deterministic solid-white and solid-black official one-plane frames with BUSY evidence after replacement.
Established positive PREVGH1 and negative PREVGL1 refresh rails, or equivalent vendor-specified rail evidence.

items.summary: Historical GDEY0154D67-T03 refresh observations are retained as context, but the current panel is not accepted: official one-plane white and black transfers now complete with BUSY while both physical frames fail, PREVGH1 remains near 3.3 V, PREVGL1 remains near 4.2 mV, and the panel stays black-white grain.
